transformation: Skymaze one-way descending platforms become seven procedurally drifting terraces. A continuously forward-moving walker steers laterally with inertia, inherits moving-deck velocity and falls under gravity. A visible side section and bounded forecast expose height and motion; no jumping or upward recovery.
assets: Independent procedural canvas artwork. No copied source code, textures, geometry or runtime.
source_license: DeepMind Lab GPL-2.0; idea only, no source code vendored.
limitations: Reduced kinematic walker and contact model, not a full rigid-body simulator.
